quoteText: Any fool can write code that a computer can understand. Good programmers write code that humans can understand.
bioIntro: Front-end Developer passionate about building modern, functional interfaces with an eye for the details that make a real difference in the user experience.
aboutP1: I'm Fernando Junior, a Front-end Developer with 2+ years of experience, detail-obsessed and passionate about design that feels as good as it looks.
aboutP2: Fascinated by the full spectrum of creation, from UI/UX concepts and web design to component architecture and how users interact with functional, intentional interfaces.
aboutP3: I constantly come up with new project ideas and make a point of bringing them to life. I love exploring components, crafting beautiful interfaces, and turning rough concepts into polished products.

companyDolphinDesc: Brazilian software company focused on technological solutions, developing AgroCRM, a complete platform for sales management and customer relationships for companies across various industries.
expDolphinFrontDesc: Developing a new AgroCRM platform using modern architecture, building a rich component library including comboboxes, date inputs, and file uploads. Working collaboratively with multiple developers in a monorepo, while also building from scratch a cross-platform mobile app with offline-first support using Expo and React Native.
expDolphinFrontBullet1: Built reusable form components and a cross-platform mobile app with offline sync from scratch
expDolphinFrontBullet2: Collaborated with multiple developers in a structured monorepo with MVVM architecture and strong DX practices
expDolphinBackDesc: Developed and maintained RESTful APIs using GeneXus, handling CRUD operations and backend optimizations in close collaboration with frontend and support teams.
expDolphinBackBullet1: Created and maintained CRUD operations with performance-focused optimizations
expDolphinBackBullet2: Worked closely with the frontend team to align API contracts and resolve integration issues
